E4.expanded_multitrip_claim: requires new optimization; post-hoc repacking is a feasibility witness only

E6.expanded_multitrip_claim: all coalition values and allocation outputs require re-estimation after multitrip optimization

strict_conditions_for_single_trip_specia: Each saved route is one trip and is assigned a distinct physical vehicle, so every physical vehicle has trip_count=1 and no two routes share an asset.

The saved route order, vehicle type, home depot, customer coverage, charging amount and clock, time windows, payload, battery, two-by-22kW depot capacity, public-station capacity and service horizon are unchanged.
E4 retains its saved 60%-20%-80%-next-day-60 ContinuousSOCContract and all 270 terminal-charge ledger rows; E6 retains the corrected inherited-SOC and certificate-departure clock semantics.

The available CV/EV vector remains the legacy experiment vector. A Y2 level claim additionally requires exact per-depot vector equality under Hamilton allocation; headline percentage equality is insufficient.
All comparison arms use the same trip_count=1 restriction. The result is described as the restricted submodel result, not the optimum of the expanded multitrip feasible set.
If any saved row is changed, or if it is mapped to a Y2 level, that row must be rechecked for fleet caps, complete certificate legality and objective/component identity.
